- NetProtocol CLI gotcha discovered: each `netp profile set-*` transaction overwrites the entire metadata blob. To preserve fields, pass `--address` to merge current onchain metadata and re-encode only after the prior transaction confirms. The initially pre-encoded display-name/bio/X transactions overwrote one another; two merged corrective transactions restored all fields. (src: memory/2026-09-21.md:392)

- The deployment failure was traced to the test/debug harness’s constructor ABI layout: it placed the three dynamic-string tails before the static `bytes32`, `address`, and `uint96` head words. ABI requires all six head words first, followed by the dynamic tails. This malformed calldata produced panic `0x41` (memory allocation error). A trivial string-constructor deployment through the same compiler/Anvil pipeline succeeded, so the pipeline itself was not the cause. (src: memory/2026-09-24.md:712)

- Verified research result: ERC-8048, “Onchain Metadata for Token Registries,” is a **Draft** standards-track ERC created 2025-09-30 by Prem Makeig (@nxt3d) and Rafael Abuawad. It defines a minimal fully onchain token metadata interface `metadata(tokenId, key) -> bytes` (ERC-165 interface ID `0xdf670be1`) for ERC-721/1155/6909, plus optional authority/hooks/storage/sidecar extensions. Its agent-facing ERC-721T profile reserves keys for context, MCP/A2A/web/x402 endpoints, and chain-specific addresses/accounts. (src: memory/2026-09-27.md:3080)

- `mainnet.base.org` briefly returned empty code for the freshly deployed CREATE2 address even though the deployment receipt was successful; a later read returned 2,137 bytes of runtime code and all registry views passed. - Bankr `/wallet/submit` mutated the factory deployment transaction before broadcast: requested calldata was 2,468 bytes but the mined transaction had 2,497 bytes (29 trailing bytes appended), and the requested 681,175 gas limit became 786,654. The ABI-decoded `deploy(bytes,bytes32)` arguments remained intact, and the mined transaction successfully deployed the registry. Future Bankr submissions must be verified from the mined transaction rather than assumed byte-identical to the request. (src: memory/2026-09-28.md:3202)
